name: Google Student Researcher Program
amount: Salaried; e.g. US base $98,000–131,000/yr pro rata, NL/DE €68,500–86,500/yr pro rata
dlText: Rolling per posting · 2027 EMEA posting asks for applications by 13 Dec 2026
fields: Computer science, AI/ML and related technical fields
note: Flexible research placements with Google Research, DeepMind and Cloud teams; postings are split by degree level and region (US, EMEA, etc.) and reviewed on a rolling basis. You must keep student status and usually stay in the host country for the whole placement.

name: Google DeepMind Student Researcher Program
amount: Paid (salary set per location; check official page)
tags: In person at a Google office
fields: AI research and related fields
note: Placements of 12–24 weeks with a Google DeepMind host team, in person at a Google office. Specific openings are listed on Google Careers; work authorisation for the office country may be needed.

name: Microsoft Research Internships
amount: Paid (salary set per location; check official page)

fields: Computer science, AI, HCI, systems, algorithms and related
note: Paid research internships (typically 12 weeks) at MSR labs such as Redmond, Cambridge, Montréal and New York; candidates must normally be enrolled in a PhD. Each posting sets its own location rules (e.g. Montréal requires being in Canada/USA).

name: MSR Asia Stars of Tomorrow Internship Program
amount: check official page
fields: Computer science, AI and related fields
note: MSRA's flagship internship with 400+ places a year for students worldwide, lasting 3–18 months with training, talks and mentoring. Roles are posted on the MSRA opportunities page (Beijing, Shanghai and now Singapore).

name: MSR Asia StarBridge Program
amount: check official page
fields: Computer science, AI and related fields
note: Rolling research internship at MSRA for students who have deferred enrolment at a leading graduate school. Check the official page for pay and current terms.

name: Microsoft PhD Applied Science & Engineering Internships
amount: Paid (salary set per location; check official page)
dlText: Rolling · accepted Sep–Apr of the academic year
fields: Applied science, ML, software and hardware engineering
note: PhD internships on Microsoft product teams (separate from Microsoft Research). Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis through the academic calendar (September–April).

name: Meta Research Scientist Internships (PhD)
amount: Paid (salary set per location; check official page)
fields: AI/ML, computer vision, speech, robotics, alignment
note: Many PhD research intern postings across FAIR, Meta Superintelligence Labs and Reality Labs, lasting 12–24 weeks with various start dates. You must obtain and keep work authorisation in the country of employment; publications at top venues are preferred.

name: Apple AIML Residency Program
amount: Paid (salaried one-year position; check official page)
dlText: 2027 cycle not yet announced · past cycles closed in January
fields: Machine learning and AI, plus STEM experts moving into ML
note: A one-year salaried residency that places master's/PhD graduates, postdocs, engineers and academics on sabbatical in Apple ML teams; it is for graduates rather than current students. The 2027 call is not out yet; earlier cycles opened late in the year and closed in January.

name: NVIDIA Research Internships
amount: Paid; e.g. US PhD postings $38–94/hour
fields: ML, graphics, computer vision, robotics, architecture, EDA
note: Research internships for graduate students across NVIDIA Research areas; each posting has its own pay range and closing date. Work authorisation for the posting's country may apply.

name: Amazon Applied Scientist Internships
amount: Paid stipend or salary (set per location; check official page)
dlText: Rolling · 2027 postings open, start dates year-round
fields: ML, NLP, computer vision, robotics, automated reasoning, GenAI
note: Amazon hosts 2,000+ science interns a year; one application is matched to science teams, with 3–6 month placements and start dates through the year. Some regional postings require enrolment at a local university (e.g. Canada).

name: Adobe Research Internships
amount: Paid; US range $45–61/hour (varies by location)
fields: Computer vision, NLP, HCI, graphics, audio, AI
note: Mentored research internships that often lead to papers and product features; 2027 applications are open and stay open based on hiring needs. Interns work from the office where their mentor is based.
